subject: Literature
title: Murasaki Shikibu and the World's First Novel
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Murasaki Shikibu and the World's First Novel.

hook.text: The world's first novel was written by a woman in eleventh-century Japan, a thousand years before the modern novel emerged.

buildup.text: Murasaki Shikibu was a lady-in-waiting at the imperial court who wrote The Tale of Genji around the year 1000.

discovery.text: Genji explores psychological depth, romantic complexity, and the passage of time with a sophistication unmatched for centuries.

twist.text: We do not even know her real name. 'Murasaki Shikibu' is a nickname, and her identity remains partially a mystery.

climax.text: She invented the novel as a literary form, proving that women were creating groundbreaking literature a millennium ago.

punchline.text: A woman invented the novel a thousand years before anyone noticed.

quiz.question: What literary milestone is attributed to Murasaki Shikibu?
options: She wrote the first autobiography in world literature
She wrote the world's first novel, The Tale of Genji
She created the first dictionary of the Japanese language
